brands.name: Ask For Luigi
brands.tagline: Fresh, handmade pasta and family-style dishes designed to share.
brands.description: Ask For Luigi is a Michelin Recommended, casual and intimate Italian-inspired restaurant in Vancouver's Railtown neighbourhood, specializing in fresh, handmade pasta and family-style dishes. All dishes arrive family-style, in the middle of the table as they are prepared.

colors.name: Gold
colors.usage: Primary brand accent — headings, nav, buttons, borders

fonts.notes: Headings, navigation — always uppercase, letter-spacing 0.095em, gold color
All body copy, weight 100. Near-black. Fluid 14–18px.
Buttons only — uppercase, letter-spacing 0.12em, inside custom SVG cartouche shape.

voiceAttributes.description: Every interaction feels like being welcomed into someone's home, not a restaurant.
examples: Just like Nonno used to make

voiceAttributes.description: Michelin-recommended but never stuffy. The food is serious; the attitude is relaxed.
Every dish connects to a real place, a real memory, a real person.
examples: He didn't believe in buying food you could grow yourself
The way it's always been done

voiceAttributes.description: Family-style service is a statement of values. Food lands in the middle of the table for everyone.
examples: Order more than you think you need
The table is always bigger than the plate

voiceAttributes.description: The ritual of dining together takes time. Copy never rushes. It invites you to linger.

brands.logoNotes: Primary logo: gold (#A27E51) on transparent. Reverse logo: white on transparent. Use reverse on emerald (#10312B) and dark backgrounds. SVG format — scale freely. Maintain clear space equal to cap-height of wordmark on all sides.

brands.name: Carlino
brands.tagline: Simple and soulful — the cuisine of northern Italy, reimagined with BC's finest.
brands.description: Michelin Recommended. Inspired by Friuli, northern Italy. Hyatt Vancouver Downtown. Pasta made fresh daily. Seasonal, hyper-local sourcing — including eggs from their own Abbotsford farm.

fonts.notes: Elegant serif for headings — suggest italic for hero text.
Warm readable serif for body copy.
Clean sans-serif for navigation, labels.

voiceAttributes.description: The cooking has feeling behind it — restrained, confident plates. Nothing flashy. Everything intentional.
BC and northern Italy share the same geography of spirit — mountains, forests, clean water, small farms.
examples: The mountains in the north of Italy look like ours

voiceAttributes.description: Michelin-recommended and hotel-located, but the tone never stiffens.
examples: Come for breakfast. Stay for everything.

voiceAttributes.description: The menu changes because the land does.
examples: What the garden gave us this morning

voiceAttributes.description: Every sourcing decision has a reason. The eggs from the Maran hens aren't a talking point — they're a value made visible.
examples: It matters where it comes from

brands.name: Di Beppe
brands.tagline: A young Italian restaurant with an old Italian soul.
brands.description: Gastown ristorante, caffè, deli and grocer. Inspired by the Italian immigrant's desire to share a piece of home. Family-friendly. Caffè transitions from morning espresso to wine bar by night.

colors.name: Linen
colors.usage: Primary background — directly from brand meta theme-color

fonts.notes: Confident editorial serif. Mix regular and italic.
Warm readable serif for body copy.
Light sans-serif for labels, nav.

voiceAttributes.description: Di Beppe carries the emotional weight of an Italian who packed their culture into a suitcase and rebuilt it in a new city.
examples: A piece of home, far from home
The recipes that crossed the ocean
What Italy tastes like when you miss it

voiceAttributes.trait: Old world charm, new world energy
voiceAttributes.description: The soul is old Italian — unhurried, warm, opinionated about food. But the space and audience are young, modern Vancouver.
examples: An old soul in a Gastown building

voiceAttributes.description: Di Beppe is not one thing — it's a caffe, a deli, a ristorante, a grocer, a pastry shop.
examples: Start with an espresso. Stay for the pasta.
Morning to night, we've got you

voiceAttributes.description: Italians are not shy about food. Di Beppe has a point of view.
examples: We don't compromise on the pasta

voiceAttributes.description: Gastown's Italian anchor. Familiar, reliable, yours.
examples: Part of the neighbourhood since day one

brands.name: Farina a Legna
brands.description: Cozy Northern Italian pizzeria in Lower Lonsdale, North Vancouver. Wood-fired brick oven is the heart. Classic and creative pizza plus handmade pasta. Community-focused neighbourhood restaurant.

colors.name: Ember
colors.usage: Primary accent — fire, ember, burnt orange

fonts.notes: Confident Italian editorial serif for headline use.
Readable serif for body copy and menus.
Condensed sans-serif for labels, nav, categories.

voiceAttributes.description: Farina is North Van's Italian restaurant. Not a destination — a neighbour.
examples: For the people who live here

voiceAttributes.description: The oven is the identity. Everything radiates from that brick oven.
Purists and non-traditionalists both welcome. The voice never makes anyone feel like they ordered wrong.
examples: Classic or creative — both are right

voiceAttributes.description: The craft is real but never performed for the audience.
Farina is a warm room on a North Van evening.

brands.name: Giovane Caffè
brands.tagline: Tempting even the strictest of espresso purists.
brands.description: Italian coffee bar at Fairmont Pacific Rim and W Georgia St, plus Toronto. Inspired by the modern Italian caffè bar. Classic and modern espresso drinks.

colors.name: Brass
colors.usage: Brand accent — brass fixtures, warm metallic

fonts.notes: Elegant light editorial serif. Thin weight creates refinement.
Clean, precise grotesque for body copy.
Condensed serif for pull quotes and callouts.

voiceAttributes.description: Giovane is serious about coffee. The voice reflects that precision — specific, knowledgeable, confident.
examples: This espresso was made for this milk
We measured so you don't have to

voiceAttributes.description: The Italian caffè tradition updated for a sophisticated contemporary audience.
examples: Italy taught us. We kept learning.

voiceAttributes.description: Giovane doesn't need to announce its quality. The confidence is expressed through restraint.
A coffee bar that can satisfy even the most demanding espresso drinker.
examples: The standard you were looking for

voiceAttributes.description: Located in the Fairmont Pacific Rim — the physical context requires polish.
examples: A considered start to your day

brands.name: Gigi's
brands.tagline: Italian roots. Local ingredients. A love letter to Nonno.
brands.description: Newest KTR concept (June 2025), Coquitlam. Named after Nonno Gigi. Handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza, burrata bar, Italian wine. Rooftop Bar Lucia upstairs. Italian roots, west coast ingredients.

colors.name: Forest Night
colors.usage: Primary dark — evening gathering, Bar Lucia

colors.name: Sage
colors.usage: Secondary accent — herbs, garden, west coast

colors.name: Gold
colors.usage: Highlight — Bar Lucia elements and special moments

fonts.notes: Warm editorial serif. Mix regular and italic for personality.
Clean, warm grotesque bridging Italian warmth and west coast simplicity.
Italic serif for the love-letter moments.

voiceAttributes.description: Gigi's is explicitly framed as a love letter — to Nonno Gigi, to Italian summers, to the table.
examples: Every summer had a table like this
The recipe he never wrote down

voiceAttributes.description: As the newest KTR concept, Gigi's has a youthful energy. It celebrates, it welcomes, it delights.
examples: The burrata just arrived from Italy

voiceAttributes.description: Italian roots, BC ingredients. The voice bridges both.
examples: What Nonno would have made with BC seafood

voiceAttributes.description: Opened in Coquitlam — a broader audience. The voice is welcoming to everyone.
The Nonno narrative gives every touchpoint a story to tell.
examples: Nonno Gigi taught us this one
The summers that shaped this menu

brands.name: Mercato di Luigi
brands.tagline: Cook like we do back in Italy.
brands.description: Italian grocer and caffè, two Vancouver locations. E 12th: quaint grocer/caffe. Georgia St: modern grocer, caffè and in-house bakery.

colors.name: Bottle Green
colors.usage: Primary brand colour — Italian grocer signage energy

colors.name: Vermillion
colors.usage: Accent — Italian deli, tomato, new arrivals

colors.name: Kraft
colors.usage: Secondary warm — paper bags, Italian packaging

fonts.notes: Bold slab serif — Italian grocer signage energy.
Clean humanist sans for body and labels.
Light slab serif for secondary headings.

voiceAttributes.description: Mercato is first and foremost a store — a place to shop, to browse, to discover Italian ingredients.
examples: The pasta you've been looking for

voiceAttributes.description: Not a special occasion. Mercato is Tuesday morning espresso and Thursday lunch pasta.
The staff know Italian food deeply. The voice shares that knowledge without gatekeeping.
examples: How to use it at home
The Italian way to store pasta

voiceAttributes.description: Caffè energy — short interactions, warm service, efficient.
examples: In and out, always worth it

voiceAttributes.description: Two Vancouver locations, each embedded in their neighbourhood.
examples: Part of the block for years

brands.name: MONZO Burger
brands.tagline: Fast food the way it was meant to be. #BestinBeef
brands.description: Italian-inspired fast-casual smashburger at Vancouver House. Inspired by 1980s Milanese 'Paninari' youth movement. Custom-ground Canadian beef, hand-made chicken cutlets, beef fat fries, soft serve gelato.

colors.name: Red
colors.usage: Primary accent — Italian flag energy, urgency, appetite

colors.name: Yellow
colors.usage: Secondary accent — fast food heritage reclaimed

colors.name: Chrome
colors.usage: Secondary neutral — metallic, Vancouver House aesthetic

fonts.notes: The definitive Italian modernist typeface. Condensed, bold, graphic. All caps.
Clean system-level Helvetica for body and UI.
Ultra-heavy display weight for hero moments, merchandise, social graphics.

voiceAttributes.description: MONZO knows it makes the best burger in Vancouver. #BestinBeef is a statement, not a question.
examples: This is what a burger should be
We settled this a while ago

voiceAttributes.description: The Paninari reference is real — this is a brand where food and culture intersect.
examples: Where food, fashion and culture meet

voiceAttributes.description: Counter service, open late, smashburger energy. The copy is fast. Short sentences. Bold claims.
examples: The fries are cooked in beef fat.

voiceAttributes.description: The tone is fun and bold, but the obsession with ingredients is genuine.
examples: We took our time on this one

voiceAttributes.description: Like the Paninari, MONZO is about building community through shared food, friendship, and hospitality.

brands.name: Pourhouse
brands.tagline: Embracing the sublime pleasure of drink, the joy of good food, and the comfort of family.
brands.description: Historic Gastown cocktail bar and restaurant, 1910 Leckie Boot Company building. Douglas fir ceilings, brick walls, 38ft handcrafted bar. Old-fashioned soul cocktail program. Hearty food, Sunday live jazz.

colors.name: Bourbon
colors.usage: Primary dark — deep whiskey brown, aged wood

colors.name: Brass
colors.usage: Primary accent — bar fixtures, aged metal

fonts.notes: Classical editorial serif with gravitas. Pre-Prohibition bar authority.
Authoritative newspaper serif. Reads like a menu from a serious establishment.
Classic American typeface for secondary elements. Historically appropriate.

voiceAttributes.description: Pourhouse looks backward deliberately — to pre-Prohibition drinking culture, to century-old buildings, to the craft of the classic cocktail.
examples: Nothing new about a well-made cocktail

voiceAttributes.description: The 38ft reclaimed Douglas fir bar, the 1910 bones — the physical space is the primary storytelling device.
examples: The bar has heard it all
This room has a century of stories in it

voiceAttributes.description: Hearty, mouth-watering food — Scotch Egg, Pourhouse Burger, Wagyu tartare. Serious but still comfort food.
examples: The best Scotch Egg in Vancouver
Comfort food that earned its reputation
Come for the cocktail. Stay for the burger.

voiceAttributes.description: Pourhouse is a Gastown institution. That neighbourhood identity is in the voice.
Unabashed enjoyment, not performance. The sublime pleasure of drink, the joy of good food.
examples: This is what a good evening feels like
